$comment: DRAFT. Single source of truth for Name / Address / Phone (NAP) on every listing, profile, directory and schema block. Written by hand from src/lib/data/catalogue.ts (STORES); tests/unit/marketing-seo-external.test.ts proves every store field below equals STORES exactly. If STORES changes, this file must change in the same commit. Internal planning file: it may carry [CONFIRM] markers, but nothing here is pasted onto a customer-facing surface without being checked against the claims ledger.

business.listingNameRule: Use the real-world name exactly as shown on the shopfront sign. Do not add a suburb, a keyword, a tagline or the words catering, bakery or Lebanese to the listing name. Google's guideline: the name must reflect the real-world name used consistently on the storefront, website and stationery, with no marketing taglines (https://support.google.com/business/answer/3038177, retrieved 2026-10-02).
business.schemaNameNote: src/lib/seo.ts emits 'Dough Boss Revesby', 'Dough Boss Bankstown' and 'Dough Boss Roselands Centro' as the Bakery name. That differs from the GBP listing name 'Dough Boss'. [CONFIRM: Elie to choose one rule. Recommendation: GBP listing name 'Dough Boss' on all three; keep the suburb form in schema and page titles, because the address is what tells the three apart.]
business.instagramSource: Owner-published site footer and src/lib/seo.ts INSTAGRAM_URL. [CONFIRM: handle is owned and active.]
business.legalEntityAndAbn: [CONFIRM: operating entity name and ABN. Needed for the Spam Act sender block, Apple Business Connect and ABN-linked directories.]

A tracking number as the primary phone (it breaks citation matching). Use call tracking only as an additional number, and only after Elie agrees

canonicalAddressFormat.rule: Write the address exactly as in each store's 'canonical' string below. Use 'Rd', 'Pde', 'Dr', 'Ave' as typed in STORES. Put the unit or shop number as typed ('12/25', 'Shop MM03'). Do not write 'Shop 12/25' or 'Road'.
canonicalAddressFormat.status: [CONFIRM: check each address in the Australia Post address lookup and in Google's address autocomplete before the first profile is claimed. Re-check the Roselands centre name, because the centre may now trade under a new name.]

publicHolidayHours.note: Public-holiday trading hours are not stated in any source we hold. Do not list any holiday as open or closed. [CONFIRM: per-store public-holiday hours; then set them as GBP special hours at least two weeks ahead.]
